title: ELF BAR ELFX 2 Pod Vape Kit
description: The Elf Bar Elfx 2 pod vape kit builds upon the foundation of its predecessor with significant upgrades, offering a versatile and reliable device for both mouth-to-lung and restricted direct-to-lung vapers. Constructed from a lightweight aluminium alloy, it combines a premium feel with everyday practicality and a highly ergonomic grip. Powered by a substantial 1700mAh built-in battery, the Elfx 2.0 delivers up to 30W of adjustable power. Users can easily navigate between three distinct power modes using a single button: Eco mode to conserve battery, Normal for a balanced draw, and Power mode for maximum vapour production. The immersive tidal light indicator provides instant visual feedback on your current setting, alongside a three-stage LED system to monitor your battery level. Designed for simplicity, the device features a responsive auto-draw activation system, allowing you to inhale directly without pressing buttons. The kit includes two Elfx 2.0 refillable pods equipped with QUAQ DURA vertical dual mesh coils. This technology alternates heating between two meshes, extending coil lifespan and ensuring consistent vapour and flavour delivery from the first puff to the last. Complete with a comprehensive 5A leakproof design and a convenient top-fill system, the Elf Bar Elfx 2.0 offers an accessible yet highly capable setup for vapers seeking an effective alternative to combustible tobacco. We recommend pairing this kit with 50/50 , Nic salt or High PG E-Liquid For the ultimate Elf Bar experience, pair the ELFX 2 pod kit with Elf Bar’s ElfLiq range of 50/50 Nic Salt e-liquids, featuring classic Elf Bar flavours. Please note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
